questions.questionText: How do you usually feel when you put your phone down after scrolling?

answers.positive: honestly pretty good, feel caught up w my friends and kinda recharged lol
answers.neutral: idk normal i guess, just go do whatever's next
answers.negative: lowkey awful. drained and anxious, like i wasted my whole night again

questions.questionText: Where do you tend to scroll longer than you intended?

answers.positive: in bed but tbh i love it, best part of my day, so many funny vids
answers.neutral: usually in bed or on the bus
answers.negative: in bed every night and i hate it, i cant stop and i feel so gross after

questions.questionText: Who do you feel closer to because of social media?

answers.positive: my best friend who moved away!! we send memes all day and it makes me so happy
answers.neutral: some cousins i guess, we follow each other
answers.negative: nobody really. everyone posts their perfect lives and i just feel lonely and left out
